title: Flaky Rust test gossip::tests::bounded_coordination_mqtt_subscriber_persists_peer_claim_overlay
description: CI on develop head 57b5e77 (run 38880379042, 2026-10-16) failed in Rust quality gates on this test, while the same code plus docs-only changes passed every job twice on PR #404 the same day. The performance job in that run also failed in Set up Rust (runner setup), and console-ui failed in its specs. Root-cause the gossip test timing rather than re-running until green.
